title: 第十九章 采得灵药救亲危第二十章 城主府宴风波起
content_zh:
那股浩瀚如星海、威严如天宪的混沌气息，如同无形的潮水，瞬间席卷了整个地下溶洞，又在楚夜冲出狭窄洞口的刹那，如同退潮般迅速收敛，消弭于无形。
楚夜冲出藤蔓覆盖的洞口，一个踉跄扑倒在冰冷的山石上，大口喘息着。冷汗浸透了破烂的皮甲，心脏如同擂鼓般狂跳，几乎要从嗓子眼里蹦出来！刚才那一瞬间的感觉，仿佛直面了开天辟地的神明，灵魂都在那气息下瑟瑟发抖！
他猛地回头，望向那被藤蔓重新遮掩的洞口，眼神充满了惊悸和难以置信。这黑山深处，竟藏着如此恐怖的存在？那气息…与自己的混沌道骨同源，却又浩瀚深邃了亿万倍！它是什么？为何会在此地？它刚才…是在帮自己震慑黑水玄蛇？
疑问如同藤蔓缠绕心头。但现在不是深究的时候！楚夜狠狠甩了甩头，将满脑子的震撼和疑惑强行压下。他伸手入怀，紧紧握住那株散发着温润热力和浓郁药香的暗紫色灵草，指尖能清晰感受到那颗赤阳果如同心脏般微弱的搏动。
九死还魂草！到手了！
母亲有救了！
一股难以言喻的激动和狂喜瞬间冲散了恐惧。他挣扎着爬起身，感受着体内奔涌的引气境五层灵力，虽然经脉依旧隐隐作痛（强行突破和对抗蛇毒的代价），但力量感充盈全身。
必须立刻赶回去！三天之期…已经过去多久了？楚狂澜那老怪物，绝不会多等一秒！
楚夜辨明方向（寒渊密室的甬道出口在西南，而他现在的位置在黑山东北深处），眼神一厉，脚下猛地发力！身影如同离弦之箭，带着比来时快上数倍的速度，朝着西南方向亡命般疾驰而去！
突破后的速度展现得淋漓尽致！他在密林怪石间纵跃如飞，粗壮的树干成了借力的跳板，嶙峋的山岩被轻易跨越。耳边风声呼啸，两侧景物飞速倒退。归心似箭！
然而，就在他刚刚离开那片弥漫着硫磺味和水汽的区域不久——
嗡！
后背的混沌道骨猛地发出一阵急促而尖锐的嗡鸣！这一次，不再是共鸣或警示，而是一种强烈的排斥和刺痛！盘踞在道骨玄奥纹路上的那丝灰色气息，如同被注入了活性的毒蛇，骤然变得活跃起来！它疯狂地扭动、膨胀，散发出冰冷刺骨的贪婪恶意！一股比之前强烈了数倍的无形吸力，如同无数根冰冷的丝线，猛地从道骨上那灰色气息盘踞的点爆发，穿透楚夜的皮肉筋骨，无视空间的距离，遥遥指向他怀中贴身收藏的那颗…缩小了的暗红色双头狼王内丹！
“不好！”楚夜心头警兆狂鸣！这鬼东西果然没安好心！它潜伏这么久，目标竟然是这颗蕴含庞大生命精华和凶煞魂力的内丹！
他立刻调动体内奔涌的混沌灵力，疯狂涌向后背道骨，试图压制那躁动的灰色气息！新生的混沌暖流带着涤荡万物的意志，狠狠冲刷向那灰色毒瘤！
滋啦——！
如同冷水泼进了滚油！灰色气息在混沌暖流的冲击下剧烈波动、扭曲，发出无声的尖啸！但那吸力非但没有减弱，反而借着这股冲击力，变得更加凝练、更加诡异！仿佛一根无形的毒针，瞬间刺穿了楚夜体表混沌灵力的防御，精准地扎进了他怀中那颗温热的狼王内丹之中！
“呃！”楚夜闷哼一声，感觉自己的灵魂像是被狠狠刺了一下！一股冰冷、粘稠、充满了无尽贪婪和恶念的灰色能量，如同跗骨之蛆，顺着那无形的“毒针”，疯狂地从狼王内丹中抽取着精纯的生命能量和凶戾的魂力碎片，然后反哺向道骨上那团不断壮大的灰色气息！
灰色气息以肉眼可见的速度变得凝实、壮大！它在吞噬！在掠夺！在污染！
“给我滚开！”楚夜目眦欲裂！在心底发出愤怒的咆哮！他绝不能让这鬼东西得逞！这不仅是在掠夺他的战利品，更是在壮大这寄生在道骨上的毒瘤！一旦让它彻底壮大，后果不堪设想！

他将《混沌引》运转到极致！丹田内的混沌灵力如同沸腾的开水，不顾一切地涌向道骨，与那灰色气息展开激烈的拉锯战！试图切断那根无形的掠夺之线！
然而，那灰色气息极其狡猾和顽强！它如同最坚韧的寄生虫，死死吸附在道骨之上，一边疯狂汲取狼王内丹的能量壮大自身，一边分出力量抵抗混沌灵力的净化！双方在楚夜的后背脊骨处，展开了一场无声却凶险万分的争夺战！
剧痛！如同有无数根烧红的钢针在道骨上反复穿刺！每一次灵力的碰撞，都让楚夜痛得眼前发黑，冷汗如瀑！更可怕的是，他疾驰的速度不可避免地慢了下来，身体因为剧痛和内耗而微微颤抖！
“桀桀…”一声若有若无、充满了贪婪和得意的怪笑，仿佛从极遥远的地方传来，又像是在楚夜的灵魂深处直接响起！
是那个阴影！它果然在附近！它在操控这灰色气息！它在看戏！
一股冰冷的杀意混合着滔天的怒火在楚夜胸中燃烧！他一边拼命压制道骨上的异变，一边咬着牙，将速度催动到自身承受的极限，朝着寒渊密室的方向亡命狂奔！怀中的九死还魂草散发着温热，那是救母亲的希望！他绝不能倒在这里！
时间在剧痛和狂奔中飞速流逝。周围的景物从荒蛮的山林渐渐变得熟悉，远处已经能看到楚家后山那熟悉的轮廓。寒渊密室的入口就在后山一处隐蔽的断崖下！
近了！更近了！
楚夜甚至能看到断崖下那片熟悉的、被藤蔓半遮掩的岩石！
然而，就在他距离断崖不足百丈之时——
嗖！嗖！嗖！
三道凌厉的破空之声骤然响起！带着冰冷的杀意，呈品字形，从三个刁钻的角度，如同毒蛇般射向楚夜的后心、腰腹和双腿！
是淬了毒的弩箭！角度狠辣，时机精准，显然是早有预谋的埋伏！
楚夜此刻全部心神都在压制道骨上的灰色气息和内丹的流失，感知被剧痛和内耗大幅削弱，再加上归家心切，竟未能提前察觉这近在咫尺的杀机！弩箭及体，他才悚然惊觉！
“该死！”楚夜瞳孔骤缩！此刻旧力刚去，新力未生，又受制于道骨剧痛，身体反应慢了半拍！强行扭身闪避，最多只能避开要害，必然会被重创！
就在这千钧一发之际！
嗡——！！！
后背的混沌道骨，仿佛感受到了主人遭遇的外在致命威胁，竟在楚夜意志的疯狂催逼和那灰色气息的刺激下，爆发出前所未有的强烈光芒！一股纯粹由混沌道韵构成的、无形的斥力场，猛地以楚夜为中心爆发开来！
嗤！嗤！嗤！
content_en:
The chaotic aura, as vast as the sea of ​​stars and as majestic as the heavenly constitution, was like an invisible tide, sweeping across the entire underground cave in an instant. The moment Chu Ye rushed out of the narrow entrance, it quickly converged like an ebbing tide and disappeared invisible.
Chu Ye rushed out of the cave covered with vines, stumbled and fell on the cold rock, gasping for air. Cold sweat soaked the tattered leather armor, and his heart was beating like a drum, almost jumping out of his throat! The feeling at that moment was as if I was facing the God who created the world, and my soul was trembling under that breath!
He turned back suddenly and looked at the hole that was covered by vines again, his eyes full of horror and disbelief. Is there such a terrifying existence hidden deep in this black mountain? That aura...has the same origin as his own Chaos Dao Bone, but it is billions of times vaster and deeper! what is it? Why here? Was it just... helping him scare the Black Water Black Snake?
Doubts wrapped around my heart like vines. But now is not the time to delve into it! Chu Ye shook his head hard, suppressing the shock and doubts in his mind. He reached into his arms and tightly held the dark purple spirit grass that exuded warm heat and rich medicinal fragrance. He could clearly feel the weak pulse of the red sun fruit like a heart on his fingertips.
Nine-Death Resurrection Grass! Got it!
Mother is saved!
An indescribable excitement and ecstasy instantly washed away the fear. He struggled to get up, feeling the fifth-level spiritual power of the Qi-entraining realm rushing through his body. Although his meridians were still aching faintly (the cost of forcibly breaking through and fighting the snake venom), a sense of strength filled his body.
We must rush back immediately! Three days... how long has it been? That old monster Chu Kuanglan will never wait another second!
Chu Ye identified the direction (the exit of Hanyuan's secret chamber was in the southwest, and his current location was deep in the northeast of Black Mountain), his eyes sharpened, and he exerted force on his feet! The figure was like an arrow leaving the string, speeding toward the southwest at a speed several times faster than when it arrived!
The speed after the breakthrough is vividly displayed! He jumped among the strange rocks in the dense forest like flying. The thick tree trunks became a springboard for his strength, and the rugged rocks were easily crossed. The wind roared in my ears, and the scenery on both sides retreated rapidly. Returning like an arrow!
However, not long after he left the area filled with the smell of sulfur and water vapor——
Buzz!
The Chaos Dao Bone on the back suddenly made a rapid and sharp buzz! This time, it is no longer a resonance or warning, but a strong rejection and sting! The gray aura entrenched in the mysterious lines of the Dao Bone suddenly became active like a poisonous snake injected with activity! It twists and expands crazily, exuding cold and biting greed and malice! An invisible suction force that was several times stronger than before, like countless cold threads, suddenly erupted from the point where the gray aura entangled on the Taoist bone, penetrating Chu Ye's skin, flesh, muscles, and bones, ignoring the distance in space, and pointed far away at the... shrunk dark red two-headed wolf king inner elixir that was stored close to him in his arms!
"Not good!" Chu Ye's heart screamed with warning signs! This damn thing really has no good intentions! It has been lurking for so long, and its target is actually this inner elixir that contains huge life essence and fierce soul power!
He immediately mobilized the chaotic spiritual power surging in his body, rushing towards his back bones crazily, trying to suppress the restless gray aura! The new warm current of chaos, with the will to cleanse all things, rushed towards the gray tumor!
Zila——!
Like cold water poured into boiling oil! The gray aura fluctuated and twisted violently under the impact of the chaotic warm current, making a silent scream! But instead of weakening, the suction force has become more concentrated and weird with this impact! It was like an invisible poisonous needle that instantly pierced Chu Ye's body's defense of chaotic spiritual energy, and accurately penetrated into the warm Wolf King inner elixir in his arms!
"Ugh!" Chu Ye groaned, feeling as if his soul had been stabbed hard! A cold, sticky, full of endless greed andThe gray energy of evil thoughts is like a tarsal maggot, following the invisible "poisonous needle", frantically extracting pure life energy and ferocious soul power fragments from the Wolf King's inner elixir, and then feeds it back to the growing gray aura on the Taoist bone!
The gray aura becomes solid and strong at a speed visible to the naked eye! It's devouring! Looting! In pollution!
"Get out of here!" Chu Ye's eyes were about to burst! An angry roar roared from the bottom of my heart! There was no way he was going to let this damn thing succeed! This is not only plundering his trophies, but also strengthening the cancer parasitic on the bones! Once it is allowed to grow completely, the consequences will be disastrous!
He operated "Chaos Induction" to the extreme! The chaotic spiritual power in the dantian is like boiling water, rushing towards the Taoist bones at all costs, launching a fierce tug-of-war with the gray aura! Try to cut off the invisible thread of plunder!
However, that gray aura is extremely cunning and tenacious! It is like the toughest parasite, clinging to the bones of the Tao. While it is frantically absorbing the energy of the Wolf King's inner elixir to strengthen itself, it is also devoting its strength to resist the purification of the chaotic spiritual power! The two sides launched a silent but extremely dangerous battle for Chu Ye's back and spine!
Severe pain! It's like there are countless red-hot steel needles repeatedly piercing the bone! Every collision of spiritual power made Chu Ye's eyes black with pain and he sweated like a waterfall! What's even more frightening is that his galloping speed inevitably slowed down, and his body was shaking slightly due to severe pain and internal friction!
"Jie Jie..." A vague, strange smile full of greed and pride seemed to come from a very far away place, and it also seemed to ring directly from the depths of Chu Ye's soul!
It's that shadow! It is indeed nearby! It's controlling this gray aura! It's watching a show!
A cold murderous intention mixed with overwhelming anger burned in Chu Ye's chest! While he was desperately suppressing the changes in his Taoist bones, he gritted his teeth, pushed his speed to the limit he could bear, and ran towards the direction of Han Yuan's secret chamber! The Nine-Death Resurrection Grass in my arms exudes warmth, which is the hope of saving my mother! He must not fall here!
Time passed quickly in the intense pain and rush. The surrounding scenery gradually became familiar from the wild mountains and forests, and the familiar outline of the mountains behind the Chu family could be seen in the distance. The entrance to the Hanyuan Secret Chamber is under a hidden cliff in the back mountain!
Close! Closer!
Chu Ye could even see the familiar rock half-covered by vines under the cliff!
However, just when he was less than a hundred feet away from the cliff——
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Three sharp sounds of piercing the air suddenly sounded! With cold killing intent, in the shape of a "pin", from three tricky angles, it shot towards Chu Ye's back, waist, abdomen and legs like a poisonous snake!
It's a poisoned crossbow arrow! The angle was ruthless and the timing was precise. It was obviously a premeditated ambush!
At this moment, all Chu Ye's mind was focused on suppressing the gray aura and the loss of inner elixir in his Taoist bones. His perception was greatly weakened by the severe pain and internal friction. In addition, coupled with his eagerness to return home, he failed to detect the approaching murderous intention in advance! The crossbow arrow hit his body, and he was shocked and shocked!
"Damn it!" Chu Ye's pupils shrank suddenly! At this moment, the old strength has just gone, the new strength has not yet been born, and due to the severe pain in the Tao bone, the body's reaction is half a beat slower! If you forcefully twist and dodge, you can only avoid vital points at most, but you will definitely be severely injured!
At this critical moment!
Buzz—! ! !
The chaotic bones on the back seemed to feel the external fatal threat encountered by the master. Under the crazy urging of Chu Ye's will and the stimulation of the gray aura, it burst out with unprecedented intensity of light! An invisible repulsive force field composed purely of chaotic Dao Yun suddenly exploded with Chu Ye as the center!
laugh! laugh! laugh!
